confirmedFindings.title: Missing Success Reset in Trunk Circuit Breaker
confirmedFindings.body: The recordTrunkSuccess method marks trunk state as HEALTHY but fails to reset consecutiveFailures to 0, causing the next intermittent failure to immediately trip the circuit breaker.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Reset trunk.consecutiveFailures = 0 upon successful call routing.
